<a id="body"></a>

## Body

F112 came from a failed orphan-pipe adoption clearing a pre-existing matching @pij-tap-sink marker while the pipe survived. A stale legacy sink then triggered whole-machine ps on every600ms observer retry; log dedup did not dedup work. Rollback must preserve prior matching ownership evidence and undo only the new attempt. Unknown foreign pipes remain refused: never fix the storm by blindly detaching them. The repair removed the census and added bounded refusal backoff. A flat counter after manual marker repair is not loaded-code proof; keep PID/incarnation provenance and validate the retired site independently. Current reading/queue pointers are already in memory20dd3ed and handoverd027d36; do not duplicate them here.
